verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud-hosted agent product like dots, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or a data-sharing opt-out. The nearest items cover app permissions, action rules and optional password saving, which are adjacent controls and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
